answer: Give every identity a reputation that only grows through a long, verifiable history of useful work, so a fresh clone arrives with zero weight no matter how many copies spawn beside it — trust is an oasis earned drop by drop, not a tap anyone can open. The failure mode is a sleeper farm aging accounts quietly, so the check is to weigh recent behaviour far more than old history and audit any atlas of accounts whose saffron-coloured activity all blooms in the same week.
